known_gap.reason: This image was built from branch capstats-plus-rearm, which was never merged. The PR that introduces this file cherry-picks the load-bearing commit (a71b0d0, Cb.getCaptureStats) onto main, making main's guest SOURCE byte-identical to the shipped tree -- but the IMAGE itself still comes from the unmerged SHA. Until the guest is rebuilt from a main SHA, an ancestry check on `commit` is EXPECTED to fail. That failure is correct and actionable: it means production is running a binary whose exact provenance is not on main. Clear it by rebuilding from main and letting the push step rewrite this file -- never by editing this field by hand.
known_gap.clears_when: chromeless-build.sh runs with OUR_REPO_REF=main and chromeless-kaniko-push.sh rewrites this file with the resulting main-descendant SHA
